title: Dress form (parametric, US 8 / UK 12)
source: Built by form_builder from the profile below. The profile rows were read from the founder's scan (cross-section half-width, reach to front and back, and a roundness fitted from the section area) and are the only thing taken from it: no scan vertex is in this form. The stand is assumed.
license: The profile is a table of measurements; the form is generated, not copied. Confirm the scan's origin before redistributing.
provenance: Built to the US 8 / UK 12 row of the size chart, which the founder read from the DrapeXD dress-form screen. DrapeXD's other sizes were not available.

generator.basis: Profile read from the scan dressform-scan-v01 at 15 heights (superellipse exponent fitted from the convex-hull area of a 12 mm slab, clamped 1.6-5; front/back measured from the waist section's mid-depth). Stand dimensions are ASSUMED: hem 72 cm, pole 2.4 cm across, base 28 cm across, 2 cm high.

knots.name: hip
knots.basis: widest girth below the waist, found on the scan by prepare_dressform.py (height of the profile row, plus the stand)

knots.name: waist
knots.basis: narrowest girth between hip and bust, found on the scan (height of the profile row, plus the stand)

knots.name: underbust
knots.basis: ASSUMED: 7 cm below the bust line. The scan has no distinct under-bust feature (height of the profile row, plus the stand)

knots.name: bust
knots.basis: widest girth above the waist, found on the scan (height of the profile row, plus the stand)

knots.name: neck
knots.basis: 95.5 percent of the full scan height, where the neck is taken for back waist length; a tapered neck has no single girth (height of the profile row, plus the stand)
